summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 720KB payload
details: Package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a ~720KB single-line, string-array-rotated obfuscated JavaScript payload (@bun/@bun-cjs header, ~1000-entry constant array with a rotator function, hex-mangled identifiers) unrelated to the package's declared CSS/theme purpose. This is the canonical alternate-runtime dropper pattern: a freshly downloaded alien runtime is used to execute an opaque payload so Node-based tooling and reviewers do not see it. The payload files (setup.mjs and math_init.js) sit at the tarball root outside the declared `files: ["dist"]` allowlist, indicating they were added outside the author's normal publish path and consistent with an impersonation or compromised publish under the @servicetitan scope. Executing this package's install runs arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
